root_cause.text: The driver uses regmap_field_alloc() to allocate regmap_field objects during probe but never frees them on driver removal, causing memory/resource leaks.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "The regmap_field objects allocated at player init are never freed and may leak resources if the driver is removed." The patch replaces regmap_field_alloc() with devm_regmap_field_alloc() to automatically manage the lifetime.
